items.title: Costa Rica shell entity and unauthorised foreign transactions - what ED raids at CoinDCX and Delta Exchange found
items.summary: ED said searches at premises linked to CoinDCX and Delta Exchange uncovered evidence of alleged FEMA violations involving crypto derivatives, tokenised foreign stocks and cross-border transactions. The agency is investigating payments in stablecoins and transfers to overseas affiliates.

items.summary: State Bank of India (California), a wholly-owned subsidiary of India's largest lender State Bank of India (SBI), has inaugurated its new branch in Frisco, Texas. This opening marks the subsidiary's first physical expansion beyond California, with its US branches now at eight locations. items.title: How anti-AI trade after US midterm election results is reviving Indian, Chinese stocks
items.summary: The unraveling of the AI trade after the US midterm elections is forcing investors to rethink their Asia playbook, reviving demand for out-of-favor Chinese and Indian stocks as well as companies poised to benefit from easing inflation and trade tensions.

items.title: Mint Explainer: Will Sebi’s new rules on currency derivatives help the falling rupee?
items.summary: By slashing unhedged trading limits from $100 million to $5 million, the regulator aims to curb currency speculation and ease pressure on a depreciating rupee while protecting genuine hedgers.

items.title: NIT Raipur, AKSI Aerospace join hands, set-up Centre Of Excellence: What will the new partnership focus on?
items.summary: NIT Raipur and AKSI Aerospace Group plan to establish a Centre of Excellence for aerospace and autonomous technologies, alongside a manufacturing facility. The partnership will connect research with industrial production, provide hands-on training, and support India’s indigenous drone capabilities.
